fields.statement: Verifier at 49db34e1: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheck|TestShipMerge' -count=1 passes, including new TestShipCheckDraftStops (fake gh isDraft true on a green PR, plain and --settled: exit 75, stop: line naming #7 as a draft, Passed false, no checked head recorded) and TestShipMergeDraftStops (recorded head, pr view 7 --json isDraft,state reports draft: exit 75, stop line, no gh pr merge or pr ready call, state head kept, no merge commit); existing ready-PR green and merge tests still pass with the isDraft field added. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-merge-draft|describe-golden|run-ship-change)$' passes: run-ship-merge-draft turns the fake PR draft after rebased-merge-green, the run stops at merge with 'stop: pull request #7 is a draft', status shows current step merge, no merge visit 2 and no gate-rebase-merge, zero pr merge and no pr ready in gh.log; after removing the draft flag rhiza run resume succeeds, merges once and the change set lands. describe-golden was regenerated for the new ShipMergeResponse.stop field. Diff read: draft checked in ship check after the merged short-circuit and in ship merge before fetch/merge; Rhiza never calls gh pr ready.
